elements.label: PIR wakes the thermopile for a 60 s window at 1 Hz
elements.quote: When the PIR fires, power the thermopile and sample once per second for a 60 second window.

elements.label: fall back to 10 s sampling then PIR-only
elements.quote: If no occupant is classified in the window, drop back to one sample every 10 seconds, then to PIR-only after 5 minutes of empty readings.

elements.label: report on change plus 15 min heartbeat
elements.quote: Send a radio message only when the count changes, plus a heartbeat every 15 minutes so silence is not mistaken for a dead unit.
